_comment: Hand-picked Commons files. fetch_photos.py uses these verbatim and skips the automated studio/size heuristics, which cannot tell whether a photo is editorially right for a wildlife page. Each entry here replaced something the automation chose badly.

_why.Atlantic Bluefin Tuna: automation returned a dead fish on a boat deck
_why.Channel Catfish: automation returned a juvenile dwarfed by a human hand
_why.Flying Fish: common-name collision: automation returned a Thorpe Park rollercoaster
_why.Ostrich: automation returned a two-panel montage; a centred crop landed on the seam between panels
